stage1_gate.rule: Advance only if recovered-slice tight-box IoU increases and recovered-slice median center-error fraction decreases versus G1, with R2b presence and non-recovered geometry unchanged.

reason: The remote recovered subset is 49-73 slices away from frozen-B1 reliable anchors. Nearest-anchor propagation produces zero recovered-slice IoU/coverage, while five-anchor linear extrapolation lowers normalized center-error median from 5.25 to 4.69 but still produces zero recovered-slice IoU/coverage. Neither method satisfies the predeclared geometry advancement gate.
next_research_question: If geometry recovery is revisited, it should use information local to the recovered satellite itself or a learned/cross-slice geometry mechanism, rather than extrapolating from a distant frozen-B1 anchor region. This requires a separately predeclared experiment rather than post-hoc V1a.5 tuning.
